meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查看、添加或移除代理容器能访问的主机目录清单（挂载允许列表）。它会显示当前允许的目录及读写状态，并帮你更新配置；新设置对新启用的容器自动生效。
howto.when: 当你说出“mounts”“mount allowlist”“agent access to directories”等关键词，或要求查看/添加/移除挂载允许列表时触发。

say.text: 显示当前的挂载允许列表。
say.note: 它会列出允许目录并标注只读或读写。

say.text: 把 /data 加入挂载允许列表，设为只读。
say.note: 它会验证路径并询问后写入配置。

say.text: 从挂载允许列表里移除 /tmp。
say.note: 它会更新配置文件并显示结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can view, add, or remove mount allowlist entries (host directories accessible by agent containers). It shows current entries with read-only/read-write status and updates the config. New settings apply to new containers automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'mounts', 'mount allowlist', 'agent access to directories', etc., or asks to view/add/remove the mount allowlist.

say_en.note: It lists allowed directories with read-only or read-write.

say_en.text: Add /data to the mount allowlist as read-only.
say_en.note: It validates the path, asks, then writes config.
